issue.title: Route the two remaining bat|less diff viewers through a PagerOrigin.DIFF adapter
issue.description:
Proposed by epic land agent sase-uk.land after landing epic sase-uk (A link-traversing
SASE pager). It bundles PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 1 on phase bead sase-uk.5 with two
`bat | less` call sites the land agent found still standing. Not a defect and not caused
by that epic: the epic's plan (plan:202608/link_traversing_pager.md) enumerated exactly
four pagers to unify, and neither of these two is among them.

sase-uk shipped `PagerOrigin.DIFF` and a bare-short-sha recognizer for it
(`_BARE_SHORT_SHA_RE` in `src/sase/pager/link_scan.py:169`), but no adapter ever
constructs a `PagerOrigin.DIFF` document — every builder in the tree passes
`PagerOrigin.FILE` or `PagerOrigin.BEAD`. So the diff half of the scanner is live but
unreachable, and two things are unfinished behind it:

1. `target_resolution_ref()` (`src/sase/pager/document.py`) cannot build a valid
   `commit:` ref for a DIFF-origin bare short-sha token. A commit ref needs
   `<repo>@<sha>` and the scanner has no repo context, so those links would paint and
   then toast "nothing to follow" on a press. Latent today because nothing emits DIFF
   documents; a diff adapter must either attach typed commit targets itself or take
   repo context.

2. Two diff viewers still shell out the way the four retired pagers did:
   - `src/sase/ace/change_actions.py:271-296` — `bat --color=always --paging=always`,
     falling back to `cat | less -R`, then to a bare `print()`.
   - `src/sase/ace/handlers/show_diff.py:66-78` — `bat ... | less -R` through
     `subprocess.run(..., shell=True)`, else `less -R <tmpfile>`.
   Both dead-end exactly the way the epic's problem statement describes: every path and
   short sha in the diff is plain text, and following one means quitting the pager.

Scope: add the diff adapter that builds a `PagerOrigin.DIFF` `PagerDocument` from diff
text, give it whatever repo context `target_resolution_ref` needs to turn a bare short
sha into a resolvable `commit:`/`stitch:` ref (or attach typed commit targets directly,
which is what `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/hints/_files.py` already does for
`CommitViewSpec`), and route both call sites above through it. `git show --stat | sase
pager` and `gh pr diff <n> | sase pager` — both named in the epic plan's D10 as
motivating cases — become navigable at the same time.

Verify with `just check`, plus `tests/pager/test_link_scan.py` for the DIFF-origin
recognizer and the existing `tests/ace/` diff-view suites for the two call sites.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add the diff adapter that builds PagerOrigin.DIFF pager documents, give bare short-sha spans the repo context they need to resolve, and route ace/change_actions.py and ace/handlers/show_diff.py through it instead of bat|less.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-uk's plan enumerated exactly four pagers to unify and neither diff viewer is one of them; PagerOrigin.DIFF shipped as declared scaffolding with no adapter, which the epic's own sase-uk.5 phase recorded as deferred.
